parts: IF i remove the option "ordered=names(dat2)" the model appear as below
For models with ordered outcomes, meanstructure = TRUE by default, whereas meanstructure = FALSE by default in models with only continuous outcomes (unless it is a multigroup or multilevel model).
could any one help about the problem?

It's not really a problem, but I imagine there is a semPaths() argument that can omit mean structure from the graph if you don't want to see it.
